integrity: The primary open PDF was inspected at the model definition, Theorem 1 and Eq. (3.2), the global convergence remark and truncation-stability discussion, and Appendix A.1 where the double Taylor expansion is integrated term by term. The counterexample is an exact interior parameter point, and the standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: No complete convergence region is classified for any rearranged or resummed version of the published double series.
A corrected closed integral is supplied on the equal-shape slice; outside that slice direct quadrature remains available.
Other infinite-series formulas in the article are not assessed by this finding.
title: The FEPW moment series is not absolutely convergent on its stated parameter space
